name: Deck Crawler
tagline: A Slay-the-Spire-style roguelike: build a deck and fight up a map of battles.
about: Pick the Warrior or the Assassin and climb a branching map of battles, shops, campfires and treasure rooms. Each turn you draw a hand of cards and spend mana to attack, block and apply statuses; enemies show what they're about to do. Win battles to add cards and relics to your deck and beat the boss at the top. The run saves as you go.
controls: Drag a card up onto the battlefield to play it; attacks that need a target show an arrow, drop it on an enemy. Drag a card back down to cancel. Tap END TURN when you're done. Drag the map up and down, tap a lit room to go there. II pauses. PC: the mouse, Esc pauses.
effort: Open-source game made as a Godot tutorial series
credit: Roguelike Deckbuilder by Adam Gulacsi (guladam), github.com/guladam/deck_builder_tutorial. Code and art: MIT license. Added to Lab Arcade with touch controls, a safe save loader and a back button.
